Message.Name: Yield To Maturity Message
Message.Description: This message informs about the values of particular types of yield to maturity (YTM)

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Indicates the value of the price depending on the indicator in field MessageIndicator

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds to be combined with SourceTime

Field.Name: YTM
Field.Description: Indicates the values of the Yield To Maturity depending on the indicator in field MessageIndicator

Field.Name: MessageIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates the value of the fields 'Price' and 'YTM'

Field.Name: AlgorithmIndicator
Field.Description: Field includes information about the methodology of calculating YTM

Field.Name: TradeIDNumber
Field.Description: If the field "Message indicator" = 'T', it is the unique trade number for the given instrument during the given trading session
